# #2291: Patch: the lethal hint in every offline game against the AI
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

#2102 (R2102000, PR #2177) added the lethal hint: while the human has a sure win this turn by what they can see, the board outlines the enemy hero and End turn and says "You have lethal". It shows only in a free practice game against the **Easy** AI. Extend it to every offline game against the AI, which is every game the practice worker runs:

- free practice games at **Easy, Medium and Hard**, sandbox games, games with custom cards, Try it and URL-seed games included;
- **tutorial lessons** (§9.10), which R2102000 left out.

It still never shows where no practice worker runs or no AI plays: online matches (Duos against the AI team included, which the server runs), hotseat, and replays (R768). The Lethal hint setting (Gameplay, on by default) still turns it off everywhere. Nothing about the check changes: `jackioh_ai::lethal_hint` reads only `redact(state, human)` (R185, CLAUDE.md rule 7), under `PRACTICE_LETHAL_HINT_CLOCK_MS`, and never touches `decide`, the AI's stream, the save, the fold or the replay. - `apps/web/src/practice/core.ts`, `lethalFor`: `if (game.config.difficulty !== "easy" || game.config.lesson !== undefined) return false;`. Drop the gate (keep the `try`/`catch` and the clock cap).

- At Easy, Medium and Hard, in a sandbox game and in a tutorial lesson, a board where the human has a sure win this turn shows the hint; one without shows nothing.

Follows #2102 (closed by #2177).
